decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a multi-sample offset in N/E/U around indices 485–544 with partial opposing return in N; (2) an abrupt jump in U with concurrent large N/E shifts near indices 605–664, possibly indicating a platform or unresolved return. Both involve overlapping motion types and missing samples that limit resolution of counterpart changes.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample drop in N and E around index 490–495, followed by a sustained offset in E (positive) and U (negative), with possible opposing return in N starting near index 520 but not fully resolved; the change is abrupt and spans several samples.

A sharp, multi-sample jump in U (upward) at index ~610–613 coincides with large negative shifts in N and E; the U component then plateaus at elevated level while N/E show complex superposed motion—possible platform or opposing return beginning near index 630 but ambiguous due to noise and missing samples at 647 and 658.
